excerpt: The Beijing Electron Positron Collider II (BEPCII) is a two-ring e+e- collider running in the tau-charm energy region (Ecm = 2.0-4.2 GeV), with a design luminosity of 1 × 1033 cm-2s-1 at a beam energy of 1.89 GeV.
